description: A no-commitment early market read for a vehicle: comparable listing prices near the customer (10th percentile / median / 90th), an odometer-adjusted mid, and the gap vs the insurer's offer. Not an appraisal. Nothing is stored about the customer.

acv_offer_cents.description: Insurer's offer in cents, to report the gap.

state.description: Two-letter state; used when no zip is given.
